tasks.title: Задача 1
tasks.statement:
Given a triangle ABC, let I be the center of its inscribed circle.
   The internal bisectors of the angles A, B, C meet the opposite sides in
   A0 , B 0 , C 0 respectively. Prove that
                         1    AI · BI · CI     8
                           <   0     0     0
                                             ≤    .
                         4   AA · BB · CC      27

parts.question: Приведите полное решение (с доказательством или выводом).

tasks.title: Задача 2
tasks.statement:
Let n > 6 be an integer and a1 , a2 , . . . , ak be all the natural numbers
   less than n and relatively prime to n. If

                   a2 − a1 = a3 − a2 = · · · = ak − ak−1 > 0,

   prove that n must be either a prime number or a power of 2.

parts.question: Приведите полное решение (с доказательством или выводом).

tasks.title: Задача 3
tasks.statement:
Let S = {1, 2, 3, . . . , 280}. Find the smallest integer n such that each n-
   element subset of S contains five numbers which are pairwise relatively
   prime.

                    Second Day    July 18, 1991
                       Time Limit: 4 12 hours
